Window Shopper.name: Window Shopper
Window Shopper.description: High browse volume, low cart additions, minimal purchase conversion. These users are frequent but passive — they love to look but rarely commit.
Window Shopper.crm_strategy: Deploy time-limited personalised offers and wishlist reminders triggered by their most-viewed categories. Reducing perceived friction (free returns, price match) can convert passive browsers into occasional buyers.

Researcher.name: Researcher
Researcher.description: Very high unique product views across many sessions and categories, but low purchase conversion. These users are gathering information and comparing extensively before deciding.
Researcher.crm_strategy: Deliver rich comparison content, curated 'Best of' guides, and expert reviews for the categories they browse most. A 'Price Drop Alert' feature for their bookmarked products can capture them at the decision moment.

Cart Abandoner.name: Cart Abandoner
Cart Abandoner.description: High cart addition rate but also high cart removal rate with low final purchases. Strong purchase intent signals that collapse before checkout — typically due to price sensitivity, shipping costs, or checkout friction.
Cart Abandoner.crm_strategy: Target with abandoned-cart email sequences within 1-3 hours, including a modest one-time incentive. A/B test removing shipping costs vs. small discounts. Streamline the checkout flow to reduce decision fatigue at the final step.

Impulse Buyer.name: Impulse Buyer
Impulse Buyer.description: Low pre-purchase browsing, few cart additions, but high conversion rate when they do engage. These users decide fast — usually triggered by promotional events or compelling product displays.
Impulse Buyer.crm_strategy: Maximise exposure during flash sales, limited-time bundles, and 'New Arrival' pushes. Push notifications and one-click reorder prompts perform exceptionally well for this segment. Avoid over-nurturing — they don't need research content.

Decisive Buyer.name: Decisive Buyer
Decisive Buyer.description: Moderate-to-low browse depth, rapid cart-to-purchase flow, consistent repeat sessions. These users know what they want, move directly through the funnel, and transact efficiently.
Decisive Buyer.crm_strategy: Invest in loyalty programmes and subscription offers — these users respond well to convenience-enhancing features like saved payment methods, one-click checkout, and personalised restock alerts for their favourite products.

Casual Browsing.name: Casual Browsing
Casual Browsing.description: Low intent score. Users exploring without strong purchase signals.

Purchase Hesitation.name: Purchase Hesitation
Purchase Hesitation.description: High intent signals present but no purchase completed — friction or doubt remains.

Successful Conversion.name: Successful Conversion
Successful Conversion.description: High intent score followed by purchase. The ideal funnel outcome.

Impulse Purchase.name: Impulse Purchase
Impulse Purchase.description: Low intent score but purchased anyway — triggered by moment or promotion.
